title: fix(console): AI chat keeps a draft typed before the conversation is known, and gives back a send held when a linked conversation fails to load
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLXYgtfyzgVxE3YRd4MNb3s)_

Fixes #33674
Fixes #33685

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5peXUXXQ6HU4H89s6J` · claims 6890508556 and 6890872696 · one PR for both cards, two commits (one per card), as the seat ruled.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 对话(`/ai` 全页、控制台聊天停靠栏、Studio copilot)两处输入丢失。① 会话还没确定时(打开会话链接正在加载,或新会话正在创建)在输入框里打了但没发送的文字,会话确定后不再被清空,光标停在末尾、焦点保留,不会自动发送;切换到另一个会话时草稿不跟过去(与今天一致)。② 打开会话链接后、会话还在加载时发出的消息,如果加载失败(5xx 或断网),不再永远转圈:消息退回输入框(连发两条时两条都退回,先后不变)并显示"未发送"提示,不发送任何内容;再发一次会重新加载该会话并只发一次。
- 为什么改:① 聊天面板以会话 id 为 key,id 确定时整块重建,输入框里的文字随旧面板一起丢弃(#33673 开发者实测)。② 会话加载失败的 catch 只清空 id,既不让发送去创建会话,也不通知宿主,暂存的消息就一直挂着(#33673 契约复审发现,开发者实测)。
- 风险与回滚:只改前端私有包 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的两个文件(`AiChatPage.tsx` 的 `ChatPane`、`useChatConversation.ts` 的加载失败分支),不改 `ChatbotEnhanced` 的属性、服务端、spec;面板 key 保持不变。回滚即还原本 PR(两个提交可分别还原)。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`(resolve 的 `catch` 与 `ensureConversation` 的重试分支)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`(`useComposerDraftHandoff` 与 `ChatPane` 的 `requestedConversationId`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.firstMessageDrawnAtOnce-33420.test.tsx`(新增的钉子)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev,打开 `/ai/build`,发一条消息后在会话创建期间输入第二段文字不发送:创建完成后第二段仍在输入框里。再在开发者工具把 `GET /conversations/ID` 设为 503,打开 `/ai/build/ID` 时立刻发一条消息:消息退回输入框并出现未发送提示;取消拦截后再发,只发出一次。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

### #33674: a draft typed before the pane knows its conversation survives the id remount (commit 0d69e257)

`ChatPane` is keyed on `${chatApi}:${conversationId ?? 'pending'}` in all three hosts, and the composer's text lives inside the pane, so the remount from `…:pending` to the real id dropped text typed but not sent: on a deep link whose conversation GET answers, and on a new conversation whose create answers while a second message is being typed.

- **The key stays.** Everything else in the pane (the chat runtime, its messages, the held first message's bookkeeping) belongs to one conversation and must reset with it; only the composer's text is carried.
- **New hook `useComposerDraftHandoff` (in `AiChatPage.tsx`, called by `ChatPane`).** A pending pane (no conversation id) reads its composer box (`textarea[name="message"]` inside the pane) as it unmounts and leaves the text, whether the box had focus, the chat endpoint and the conversation the host was asking for when the text was last typed. The replacing pane reads that in its mount layout effect, in the same commit, and puts the text into its empty box with the cursor at the end, focusing it when the old box had focus. Nothing is sent. A microtask drops a hand-off no pane took, so it never reaches a later, unrelated mount. The hand-off is keyed by the host's page-owned `pendingFirstMessageRef`, the one object a host keeps across the remount, so two hosts never trade drafts.
- **What is carried, and what is not.** Only from a pending pane (a pane that already had a conversation hands nothing on); only to a pane with an id on the same endpoint; and only while the host still asks for the conversation it asked for when the text was typed. That last guard is the new optional `ChatPane` prop `requestedConversationId`, which the `/ai` page passes (`urlConversationId ?? legacyConversationId`, the same value it gives `useChatConversation` as `activeId`). The dock and the Studio copilot pass nothing, which matches their `activeId: undefined`, so neither host file changes. Decision for the order's third CONTROL: opening ANOTHER conversation leaves a draft behind, both from a new chat and from an open conversation (today's behaviour), and a pin holds it.
- `ChatPane` passes the hook's recorder to `ChatbotEnhanced`'s existing `onInputChange`. No new `ChatbotEnhanced` prop, so `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` is untouched: `Clause-②: no`.

### #33685: a send held while a linked conversation loads is given back when the load fails (commit 8702038f)

On a deep link (`/ai/build/conv-7`, and the dock resuming a cached conversation the same way), a send made while `GET /conversations/conv-7` is pending is held by `useDeferredFirstSend` and recorded by `ensureConversation`. When that GET failed with a 5xx or a network error, the resolve's `catch` cleared the id without settling the surface and its `finally` dropped the recorded request, so the held message hung with its thinking dots, nothing was sent and no notice showed.

- **The `catch` now reports to the recorded send.** When a send was recorded during the failed run, the hook sets `createError` to a not-sent error (the GET's status when it had one). That is the existing #33420 / #33562 path: `useDeferredFirstSend` drops the held message and `ChatPane` hands its text (joined parts included) to `ChatbotEnhanced` as `unsentText`, so the box gets the text back with the not-sent notice. Nothing is sent and no create is made.
- **A retry works.** The `catch` marks the key as failed. The next `ensureConversation` for that key, finding nothing resolving, records the request, clears the old `createError` and runs the resolve again (a `resolveAttempt` counter in the resolve effect's deps). If the GET answers, the held message is sent once into `conv-7`, as #33567's pin shows for a GET that answers the first time.
- `fetchConversation`'s thrown error now carries `status` (the notice reads it); its 404 / 403 answer (`null`) is unchanged.
- **The 404 path keeps today's behaviour**, measured and pinned: a held send on a deep link whose GET answers 404 settles on "nothing to resume", creates a new conversation and is sent once into it, with no notice.
- The same-conversation guard in the `catch` (a failed re-read of the conversation already held keeps it) is untouched.

### Changesets

`.changeset/33674-ai-chat-draft-survives-remount.md` and `.changeset/33685-ai-chat-failed-load-gives-held-send-back.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` patch each (app-shell is private and the console's `dist` ships it), both declaration lines `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Tests

All pins are in the #33420 harness, `AiChatPage.firstMessageDrawnAtOnce-33420.test.tsx`: the REAL `AiChatPage` / `ChatDockConversation`, `ChatPane`, `useChatConversation`, `useObjectChat` transport and `ChatbotEnhanced`, driven through the composer, with `fetch` holding `GET /conversations/:id` and `POST /conversations` open until the test answers or fails them.

**#33674** (top-level describes `… a draft typed before the pane knows its conversation survives the remount`, `… switching to another conversation does not carry a draft`, `useComposerDraftHandoff — which remount carries the composer text`):

- full page and dock, path (a): text typed while the conversation GET is held is in the NEW box (the old one is detached) when it answers: same text, cursor at the end, focused; nothing sent, no create. (The dock's link is the cached conversation it resumes with the same GET.)
- full page and dock, path (b): first message sent, a second typed while the create is held; when it answers, the first is sent once and drawn once, the second is in the new box, not sent, not drawn.
- CONTROL, full page and dock: a draft in an open conversation stays in the same box, unsent.
- CONTROL, full page: a draft typed in a new chat, then another conversation opened (navigate to `/ai/build/conv-9`, its GET answers): the box is empty. Likewise from an open conversation to another.
- hook unit pins: a pending pane hands its text on; a pane that already had a conversation hands nothing on; a pane on another chat endpoint takes nothing; a hand-off no pane took in the same commit is dropped.
- CONTROL for submitted messages: the existing #33420 / #33562 / #33567 pins in the same file stay green (held and sent once).

**#33685** (top-level describe `… a send held while the conversation loads, when the load fails`, on the full page and on the dock):

- GET 503 and GET network error: the bubble goes, the box holds the message, the not-sent notice shows, nothing sent, no create.
- two sends during the held GET, then a 503: the box holds `first part\n\nsecond part`.
- retry: after the 503, sending what the box holds draws it, clears the notice, re-runs the GET; when it answers the message is sent once into `conv-7`, no create.
- CONTROL: a GET that answers sends the held message once (the dock's leg is new; the page's leg is also #33567's pin).
- CONTROL: a 404 creates a new conversation and sends the held message once into it, no notice.

The harness's held GET now also takes a network failure (`Held.fail`).

<details><summary>Red first, on origin/main 5604aeb0 (which carries #33673)</summary>

- #33674: sources at 5604aeb0, harness at commit 0d69e257: 8 failed / 14 passed. The four path pins (page + dock, paths a and b) fail `expected '' to be 'add a due date field'` / `expected '' to be 'and add a due date'`, the box comes back empty; the four hook unit pins fail `useComposerDraftHandoff is not a function` (the hook does not exist on base). Every CONTROL is green on base.
- #33685: `useChatConversation.ts` at 5604aeb0, everything else at 0d69e257, harness at 8702038f: 8 failed / 26 passed: GET 503, GET network, joined, retry, on the page and the dock (the box stays empty, the bubble stays drawn). Both CONTROLs (a GET that answers; the 404 path) are green on base, on both hosts.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs (ui vitest resolves app-shell from src, no build), each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and git diff HEAD empty</summary>

Run over the whole harness file (34 tests):

- A1, the restore write removed (`box.value = handoff.text;` to `void handoff.text;`): 5 failed / 29 passed, the four path pins and the hook pin "a pending pane hands its text to the pane that gets the id".
- A2, the requested-conversation guard made always true: 1 failed, "a draft typed in a new conversation stays behind when the user opens another one".
- A3, the pending-only guard (`if (conversationId) return;`) made never true: 1 failed, "a pane that already had a conversation hands nothing on".
- A4, the microtask expiry removed: 1 failed, "a hand-off no pane took in the same commit is dropped".
- A5, the endpoint guard made always true: 1 failed, "a pane on another chat endpoint takes nothing".
- B1, the `catch`'s report skipped (an early return after marking the key failed): 8 failed / 26 passed, the eight #33685 pins. A first attempt at this leg was refused by the tool before running (its replacement still contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not drop) and measured nothing; it was redone with a distinct replacement.
- B2, the retry branch in `ensureConversation` made never true: 2 failed, the two retry pins (page and dock).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Reachability.** Every pin drives the rendered page through the composer's real input events (`change`, `submit`) and real request timing (held then answered or failed `fetch`); the hand-off is read from the DOM box the next pane renders, not from the hook.
- **The Studio copilot** renders the same `ChatPane` with no `requestedConversationId` (its `activeId` is undefined), so it takes both fixes unchanged; it has no rendered pin of its own here, the order names the page and the dock.
- **A draft typed in a new chat before switching agent** (ask to build) is not carried: the endpoint differs. Unchanged from today.
- **The dock moving between apps:** a draft typed in the dock's pending pane of app A, then the dock moving to app B, stays in the same pane while B resolves (same key, no remount, as today) and is now kept when B's conversation lands. A draft typed in an open conversation of app A is not carried. Not pinned beyond the hook unit pins.
- **Out of scope, unchanged:** the latency of `POST /conversations`, #33561's first-message drawing, server, spec and cloud.
- **Three commits, not two.** The seat asked for one commit per card. A third commit, 8500bab4, changes four lines of the test harness (the navigate helper sets its module variable from an effect instead of during render; `react-hooks/globals` refused the first form). The branch is the thread's harness branch, so it is not rewritten (AGENTS.md multi-agent §3, criterion ①).
